output.objection: You are still asking for a human to click deploy every time we ship a new model version. That bottleneck is exactly why our release cycle is stuck at two weeks when it should be hours.
output.correction: I am not talking about the forecast job itself, which is already automated. I mean the pipeline that moves the model from the registry to the serving endpoint needs to be fully automated and strictly governed.
